image_description: A young woman standing outdoors on a grassy lawn wearing a black academic gown with wide, open sleeves and purple velvet panels on the front. She is also wearing a black mortarboard cap (graduation cap) with a tassel. Her hands are clasped in front of her, holding what appears to be a rolled diploma or scroll. The background includes other people, greenery, and a building structure.
